method: Cookierift live public deck detail DOM: verified title, author, update date, legality, and displayed main/EXTRA cards. Opened each card detail to capture canonical card number and used the displayed copy count. Alternate-art suffixes are normalized to base card number. No substitutions.
sourceHashMethod: SHA-256 over UTF-8 values joined by LF in this order: sourceId, color, name, author, sourceUrl, sourceUpdatedAt, main, extra. Card IDs are canonical base numbers in displayed source order.
